title: Anthropic · 更新日志来源更新
summary: 新增 Claude Models on Google Cloud (Anthropic managed) 发布公告，以及 Claude Opus 5.5 的 Fast mode 可用性说明。

added_lines: Fast mode is available for Claude Opus 5.5 on Claude Models on Google Cloud (Anthropic managed).

We've launched Claude Models on Google Cloud (Anthropic managed), the Claude API operated by Anthropic and reached through your Google Cloud project. Google Cloud IAM controls access. Google Cloud Marketplace handles billing.
